caption:
A new study measured how fast a lead actually goes cold.

A 2026 benchmark tracked 253,817 real B2B lead responses across 127 companies and built a full conversion curve by response speed.

Under 5 minutes: 21% convert.
Wait 30-60 minutes: 8% convert.
Wait 24 hours or more: 2.3% convert.

The study's median response time across companies is 42 hours. Only about 7% respond inside the 5-minute window.
